notes: Run at 00:09 IST, so the day has just started: every Meta and CRM figure is still zero and will rise through the day. This is a valid partial-day snapshot, not a failed pull.

CRM: the form query for 26 Nov IST (25 Nov 18:30 UTC to 26 Nov 18:30 UTC) returned 0 submissions (has_more false). A same-method check on the 25 Nov IST window returned 12 total, matching yesterday's file, so the query itself is working.

Bookings: the 2.0 Vsl Pipeline query (newest 50 deals by created date, sorted descending) had no deal created on 26 Nov, so bookings_created_today is 0. The newest deals are all dated 25 Nov or earlier.

Ad sync: CRM's Meta ad data runs only to 2026-11-23 (get_ad_connection_health, state degraded, 3 days behind today). Leads and bookings are still live, but the CRM's own cost-per-lead may lag. Fix: Lead Generation → Ad Launcher → Settings.

Campaign table: both ACTIVE campaigns show zero spend so far today. The table lists every campaign with spend this month (per data/raw_today/README.md), so paused campaigns that spent earlier in November are included. last_active is each campaign's last day with spend from a daily Meta pull (1-26 Nov). Two campaigns share the name 'Schedule | ADV | Video | 13Nov26'; the one created first (10:25 on 13 Nov) keeps the plain name, and the later one (20:09) is marked (b).
